title: Using auto completion triggers the Vulkan render driver initialization exception
body:
### Tested versions

v4.4.1.stable.official [49a5bc7b6]

### System information

Godot v4.4.1.stable - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Mobile) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6100) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-14900HX (32 threads)

### Issue description

The project crashes with a Signal 11 (SIGSEGV – Segmentation Fault). The backtrace shows no debug info (no debug info in PE/COFF executable), making it difficult to pinpoint the exact cause.
This crash is sometimes triggered when the smart prompt is triggered。
